en: Enjoy this king of sushi toppings to your heart's content. It's our house specialty.
Enjoy the melt-in-your-mouth texture and exceptional flavor of bluefin tuna with just the right amount of fat.
This is a house specialty made with the leaner part of the bluefin tuna. You won't want to miss it!
Bluefin pink fatty tuna seared to perfection. Just the right amount of fat burns away for a delicious seared taste.
One of the most requested types of sushi. We only use salmon with just the right amount of fat.
We use only the freshest squid. Its beautifully white, translucent flesh and firm texture will leave you wanting more.
This sushi features shima-aji, crown jewel of the mackerel family. You must experience the refined flavor of this fatty fish.
We top this sushi with a generous portion of fresh, fatty mackerel. You won't want to miss it.
This roll is topped with fresh salted salmon roe. These little red jewels burst in your mouth for a flavor explosion.
This sushi is made from the fresh muscle meat of different flounders. Enjoy its firm texture and milky flavor.
Enjoy the distinctive sweetness and texture of fresh shrimp, along with the slightly more potent wasabi it's paired with.
This one's for sushi lovers who enjoy the distinctive texture of the ark clam. Make sure to try it at least once!
This fresh sea urchin is guaranteed to capture the hearts of real sushi lovers with its distinctive flavor.
Enjoy this full fillet of saltwater eel simmered to tender perfection, then lightly grilled to ramp up the flavor factor.
Welcome to tuna sushi paradise! Includes prime fatty cuts, fatty cuts, lean cuts, negitoro, tuna rolls, and seared tuna.
Our chefs select only the best sushi for this set. And it changes daily, so you can enjoy something new every day!
We use only the freshest of scallops. Who could possibly resist their sweet flavor and distinctive texture?
This sushi combines the white and brown meat of the snow crab. Crab lovers can never get enough.
Our specially selected sushi is guaranteed to satisfy. Includes thirteen pieces of sushi, along with soup and salad.
Six kinds of sushi from icy northern waters: scallops, sea urchin, salmon roe, snow crab, Sakhalin surf clam, and botan shrimp.
An extravagant set with only the best sushi recommended by our chefs. Guaranteed to satisfy if you can't decide what to order!
This rice bowl is extravagantly topped with an assortment of fresh seafood. A masterpiece found nowhere else!
A recreation of one man's struggle with a fish that put up a fight worthy of a dragon. Created by our president, the Tuna King.
This is our house-special rice soup perfectly matched with spicy cod roe from Hakata and rich cheese.
We use only the finest Genkai sea bream in this extravagant rice soup.
This house favorite rice soup features a lavish mix of chicken, crab, shrimp, garlic chives, sansai, and fish roe.
Pork and garlic chives are the main feature of this stamina-boosting rice soup.
Order this for the true Hakata udon experience. Enjoy the flavor of the dashi-infused soup and the texture of the noodles.
Our house-special Hakata udon topped with a fresh egg. Mix the egg in or eat it as is. Either way, you can't go wrong.
Our house-special Hakata udon topped with tempura full of nutritious vegetables.
This old standard goes perfectly with our dashi-based soup. Topped with delectable burdock tempura that has a wonderful crunch.
This udon is topped with big, round fish cake that is deep-fried to perfection. Goes perfectly with our house udon.
Topped with plenty of juicy meat. Perfect for when you need a stamina boost.
Udon and shrimp tempura. Need we say more? Enjoy the delicious flavor of the tempura as it absorbs the dashi stock.
Udon topped with meat and burdock tempura. We offer many kinds of mixed toppings, but this is the number one favorite.
These rice balls are a must for a true Hakata udon experience. Don't forget to order them with a bowl of udon.
This rice ball is loaded with salted mackerel. Enjoy the salty, fatty goodness of the fish and the plump texture of the rice.
Kashiwa chicken simmered till it's juicy and delicious is the star of this popular rice ball.
This rice ball features a plump piece of fried shrimp. Enjoy this exquisite pairing of tempura and rice.
This rice ball is filled with only the finest eel that has been grilled to savory perfection.
This rice ball is packed with our own special okaka, dried bonito flakes seasoned with soy sauce and other secret flavors.
This rice ball is filled with spicy cod roe, Hakata's local specialty. The fresh roe and plump rice are a killer combination.
This rice ball is packed full of mustard greens with a spicy seasoning. This just might be the best rice ball filling ever!
Crunchy Japanese turnip and dried baby sardines make a perfect match for this tasty rice ball.
